1-1.label: cycle-phase minion handler 接线（delegate 到 run_cycle / 指定 phase）

decisions.q: 如何将 7 个 cycle-phase minion handler 接到 run_cycle？
decisions.answer: 每个 handler 构造 CycleOpts（ctx.data 读 dir/dry_run/pull/source_id，brain_dir 默认空串）后调 run_cycle；autopilot_cycle 用 phases=None 跑完整 cycle，其余 6 个用 phases=Some([特定 CyclePhase]) 跑单 phase，返回 CycleReport 序列化为 JSON。
decisions.note: 验证：cargo test -p zbrain-core --lib minions::handlers 7 个新测试全 ok（InMemory engine，autopilot_cycle 用 dry_run=true 防重副作用）。模板仿 backlinks.rs（读 ctx.data -> 调引擎 -> 返回 JSON）。LLM 依赖子步骤在无 ChatProvider 时按 run_cycle 既有行为 Skipped，与 CLI dream 一致。注意：lib 另有 14 个无关模块测试（search/dedup/fusion/intent、operation think dispatch、skillify、think entity/gather/sanitize）在本分支已失败，非本次改动引入（未触碰相关文件），属预存负债/环境相关，留待独立排查。

1-2.label: 现有 Rust CLI verb delegate handler 接线

decisions.q: How to split the 1-2 existing-verb cluster given reindex needs the embedding seam?
decisions.answer: Wire integrity (scan_integrity) and sync (registry.dispatch_json sync_brain) as mechanical handlers now; defer reindex (requires EmbeddingClient::from_env) to the 1-4 embedding-seam group so it is not half-wired.

1-4.label: LLM/embedding-seam handler 接线（需 infra 注入）

decisions.q: How to wire the 3 embedding-seam handlers + deferred reindex?
decisions.answer: Wire reindex/embed/embed_backfill/contextual_reindex via shared embed_pages helper (list_pages/list_stale_pages -> EmbeddingClient::from_env + embed_batch -> put_page_embedding), feature-gated behind 'embedding'. contextual_reindex performs the embed loop but defers per-chunk LLM context synthesis (needs ChatProvider injected into handler ctx) -> tracked G84. Without the feature or a configured ZEROENTROPY_API_KEY the handlers fail with a clear error.

decisions.q: contextual_reindex per-chunk LLM context augmentation (G84) how implemented?
decisions.answer: ChatProvider injected via registry DI same as subagent: ContextualReindexHandler::new(chat_provider) registered with Arc::clone in register_builtin_handlers. handle synthesizes per-page context via LLM then embeds context+compiled_truth; LLM failure falls back per-page to raw compiled_truth (llm_context_failures counted, report marked partial). embed_pages_augmented takes (slug,source_id,text) triples reusing put_page_embedding. G84 now resolved 2026-08-08.
